info.title: Ralysa control plane
info.description: Generated from services/control-plane/src/http/contracts.ts. No route accepts a user-held shared secret (AC-3).

post.summary: RFC 7009 revocation = sign-out: revokes the refresh token's whole session

200.description: Revoked, or the token was unknown (RFC 7009)

post.summary: Token endpoint: token exchange of an IdP device-flow access token (RFC 8693), refresh_token and client_credentials (private_key_jwt); authorization_code arrives with the second part of F-002-T10. No client secret is ever accepted.

400.description: invalid_request, invalid_grant, invalid_scope, unauthorized_client (device code switched off), access_denied (sign-in refused by policy) or unsupported_grant_type

503.description: temporarily_unavailable (IdP directory, token signing or audit unavailable; a refresh token is not consumed)

get.summary: Readiness: database, an active signing key, no custody violation
Enabled CLI sign-in flows and IdP endpoints

post.summary: Client-reported IdP-side failures of the device flow (AC-4): audited as auth.sign_in failure, idempotent per attempt_id, rate-limited and aggregated

get.summary: Revocations, kill-switch state and epoch for every PEP (service token; G-1)

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: The cursor of the previous response; without it the feed covers the maximum access-token TTL + 5 min

get.summary: Groups, roles and status of a user (service token)
The signed-in user, the calling session's roles and the user's groups

401.description: Missing, invalid or revoked access token
